# AGENTS.md

Canonical instructions for every coding agent working in `0thernes/planaria`.
`CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.cursor/rules/build-standard.mdc`, and `llms.txt` point here. Edit this file, never the pointers.
Full standard: [docs/build-standard.md](docs/build-standard.md) (Build Standard for LLMs v1.2.0, 90 items).

## Project

- **Name:** PLANARIA (`v2.4.0`)
- **Purpose:** Progressive holographic executable architecture (`.hbin`), Plang compiler, PVM-32 vascular anastomosis VM, 4-qubit/temporal 3D WebGL2 Studio, clean-room Python 3 differential oracle, interactive Proof Blueprint, and 6-kernel pure Lean 4.35.0 formal verification suite.
- **Owner:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`0thernes`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, `0_0@0thernes.art`, Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA — NOT an LLC).
- **Manifest:** [repo.yaml](repo.yaml) (schema: [repo-standard.schema.json](repo-standard.schema.json)) and [formalization.yaml](formalization.yaml).
- **Stack:** Zero-dependency ES2022 JavaScript (`Node.js >= 20`, WebGL2 GLSL 300 es, 48 kHz AudioWorklet), pure Python 3 stdlib differential oracle, pure Lean 4.35.0 (`module` system, `autoImplicit = false`, zero Mathlib), AMS-LaTeX (`tectonic`).
- **Layout:**
  - `src/core/` — GF(2^8), interleaved RS(254,238), Cauchy MDS, FIPS 180-4 SHA-256, Depth-8 Merkle, `.hbin` codec, torture suite
  - `src/compiler/` — Plang ISA, lexer, recursive-descent parser, register-windowed codegen, compiler entrypoint
  - `src/vm/` — PVM-32 sandboxed VM (`& 0xFFF` RAM, bounded budgets + proportional blitter fuel, transactional trap rollback, 6-organ anastomosis) & LINBIN01 linear control twin
  - `src/quantum/` — 4-qubit complex statevector (`qengine.js`: Horodecki CHSH, Mermin GHZ, WKB, Heisenberg, Zeno) & `TemporalEngine` (`temporal.js`: O(1) 360-frame RingBuffer)
  - `src/world/` — Deterministic 6.42T combinatorial generator (`generator.js`) & seeded Mulberry32 3D simulation (`game3d.js`)
  - `src/web/` — WebGL2 3D renderer, 2D visualizers, 48 kHz AudioWorklet synth, Studio UI (`index.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`)
  - `programs/` — 4 living `.plang` species (`quantum_chronicle`, `aegis_drift`, `synth_reactor`, `cipher_vault`)
  - `artifacts/` — Deterministic compiled 98,304 B `.hbin` binaries + `manifest.json`
  - `reference/` — Clean-room Python 3 cross-language differential oracle (`planaria_oracle.py`)
  - `lean/` — 7 pure Lean 4.35.0 `module` proof files (`autoImplicit = false`, incl. `AdversarialTests.lean`) + `Spec.lean`, `PlanariaProofs.lean`, `VerifyAxioms.lean`, `Challenge.lean`, `Solution.lean`, `comparator.json` (**85 theorems**)
  - `blueprint/` — Interactive zero-CDN SVG Proof Blueprint (`index.html`, `blueprint.json`, `blueprint.css`, `blueprint.js`)
  - `test/` — 30-suite verification, property-based, metamorphic, AudioWorklet DSP & regression harness (`verify.mjs`)
  - `examples/` — 3 runnable zero-dependency scripts (`01-mitosis`, `02-byzantine`, `03-xenograft`)
  - `scripts/` — Build, statistical benchmark, 12-mutant tester, 2,000-case fuzzer, Blueprint builder/checker, README axiom verifier, linter (with cross-doc theorem checker), Crossref citation verifier, Pages builder, manifest generator, repo audit
  - `paper/` & `dist/` — AMS-LaTeX white paper (`main.tex`), Markdown edition, frozen PDF & arXiv tarball
  - `docs/` — Architecture, ADRs, benchmarks, configuration, operations, threat model, preregistration, Mega-Atlas cross-check, literature search log, submission readiness dossier, FAQ, glossary, run log, 10-pass red-team review
- **Status:** active

## Commands

Every command works from a clean clone (see `justfile` and `scripts/dev.sh`):

- `just setup` — verify Node.js >=20 and compile artifacts (zero npm runtime deps)
- `just build` — deterministically compile all 4 `.plang` species to `artifacts/*.hbin`
- `just test` — run all 30 verification, property-based, DSP, regression, and example suites (`npm test`)
- `just mutate` — run 12 surgical mutants (`scripts/mutation-test.mjs`; target 12/12 killed)
- `just fuzz` — run 2,000 deterministic adversarial fuzz cases (`scripts/fuzz.mjs`)
- `just oracle` — run clean-room Python 3 cross-language differential oracle (`reference/planaria_oracle.py`)
- `just blueprint` — rebuild & verify interactive Lean 4.35.0 Proof Blueprint (`blueprint/`)
- `just axioms` — verify verbatim README axiom parity & strict `{propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}` allowlist
- `just lint` — report-only syntax, security-sink, Lean-header, cross-doc theorem, placeholder, entity, and citation checks
- `just bench` — run 4-architecture Monte Carlo + Wilson 95% CI + McNemar + Holm–Bonferroni benchmarks (`npm run benchmark`)
- `just lean` — build Lean 4.35.0 proofs (`autoImplicit = false`) and run multi-kernel verification (`leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `lake check --paranoid`, `lake comparator --paranoid`)
- `just paper` — compile `paper/main.tex` via Tectonic into `dist/Donahue_2026_planaria.pdf`
- `just reproduce` — clean end-to-end build -> test -> mutate -> fuzz -> oracle -> Lean -> axioms -> blueprint -> lint -> bench -> manifest
- `just audit` — score this repo against Build Standard v1.2.0 (`scripts/audit-repo.sh` / `Audit-Repo.ps1`)
- `just deploy` / `just rollback` — build static GitHub Pages bundle (`_site/`) / revert latest Pages release commit
- `just release X.Y.Z` — bump version manifests, commit to `main`, create plain tag `vX.Y.Z`, push

## Hard rules

- **R1.** Nothing may gate, block, or slow a commit or push. No branch protection, no required status checks, no commit/tag signing, no git hooks, no blocking lint/SAST/SBOM gates (report-only only).
- **R2.** Commit and push straight to `main`. No PRs, no feature branches. Fixes for red CI are follow-up commits to `main`.
- **R3.** CI is informational.
- **R4.** Banned: Dependabot, Renovate, PR templates, CodeRabbit, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `FUNDING.yml`.
- **R5.** One-person lean, not corporate.
- **R6.** Never fabricate any claim, number, badge, DOI, screenshot, or test result. Unverified means labeled unverified.
- **R7.** Classify every finding as exactly one of the 10 classes: `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot`.
- **R8.** Precedence: owner's explicit instruction > hard rules > Build Standard items > ecosystem conventions.

## Known traps

- **PowerShell bracketed paths:** The canonical workspace path contains `[Vibe Coded (AI)]`; always pass `-LiteralPath` to PowerShell file cmdlets.
- **CRLF vs LF in `results/lean4-audit.txt`:** Always write `results/lean4-audit.txt` with pure Unix LF (`\n`) so SHA-256 digests match Linux CI.
- **No fabricated LLC entity:** Author affiliation is `Independent Researcher (0thernes project), Spokane, WA, USA` — never claim an unformed LLC corporate entity.
- **AEGIS_DRIFT S1_CORE_LOGIC budget:** Bundle 1 (`S1_CORE_LOGIC`) has a hard 1,328-byte limit (332 PVM-32 instructions). Always verify `npm run build` after any `codegen.js` change.
- **Lean 4.35.0 `module` + `autoImplicit = false`:** EVERY `.lean` file (including `VerifyAxioms.lean`) must start with `module` on line 1; keep spec defs `@[expose] public`, bind all variables explicitly, and keep `Challenge` out of `defaultTargets` so `lake check --paranoid` sees zero `sorryAx`.
- **GitHub Pages subpaths:** Never use root-anchored `/src/...` or `/programs/...` paths in `src/web/` or `blueprint/`; always resolve relative paths (`./src/web/...`, `./blueprint/`, `new URL('../../...', import.meta.url)`).

Every substantive engineering, mathematical, and experimental claim made in PLANARIA's repository, README, and White Paper (`paper/main.tex` Table 1) is enumerated 1:1 below alongside its **exact verification boundary** (`[Theorem — Lean 4.35.0]`, `[Empirical — Paired Monte Carlo]`, `[System-Test — JS + Python Oracle]`, or `[Scope Boundary]`), **evidence artifact**, and **explicit falsification criterion ("What would prove us wrong")**.

> **Honest Scope Boundary:** PLANARIA solves **0 / 1,900** open conjectures in [`0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`](https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas) (programmatic scan archived in [docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md](docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md)). Every claim below is strictly scoped to PLANARIA's `.hbin` coding architecture, Plang/PVM-32 runtime, 4-qubit/temporal simulation, clean-room Python 3 oracle, and pure Lean 4.35.0 formalizations.

# LIMITATIONS.md — Honest Boundaries, Real-vs-Metaphor & Open Dilemmas

This document states explicitly what **PLANARIA v2.4.0** does, what it does **NOT** do, where its engineering and mathematical guarantees end, and which terms are computational metaphors rather than physical or biological claims.

## 1. Real vs. Metaphor Boundary (Strict Epistemic Discipline)

| Term Used in PLANARIA | What Is **REAL** (Verified Code & Math) | What Is **METAPHOR / NOT CLAIMED** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Planarian Mitosis / Regeneration** | Deterministic Cauchy MDS erasure coding over $\mathrm{GF}(2^8)$ with an exact-integer zero-tie placement schedule so two disjoint 50% byte halves independently reconstruct 100% of the 98,304 B binary. | **NOT** wet-lab developmental biology, bioelectricity, stem-cell morphogenesis, or a solution to Mega-Atlas `BIO-031` / `SUB-001`. |
| **Living Species / Neural / Organism** | Four deterministic PVM-32 bytecode programs (`QUANTUM_CHRONICLE`, `AEGIS_DRIFT`, `SYNTH_REACTOR`, `CIPHER_VAULT`) executing inside a 4,096-word sandboxed VM with reactive AI heuristics (`playerProfile` EMA). | **NOT** biological life, sentience, autonomous self-replicating malware, or trained deep neural networks. |
| **Vascular Anastomosis** | Explicit software fallback table (`resolveOrgan`) routing `ORGAN_CALL` from higher strata (S3/S2) down to lower strata (S1/S0) or no-op stubs when bundles lack rank $k$, with transactional RAM rollback on traps. | **NOT** surgical biology or general arbitrary x86/ARM binary hot-patching. |
| **Byzantine Immune System** | Depth-8 SHA-256 Merkle authentication filtering cells against `pinnedRootHex` (or strict unique-majority quorum $\ge 2$) prior to Cauchy matrix inversion. | **NOT** an adaptive biological immune system; without `pinnedRootHex`, a coordinated majority Sybil flood overrides unpinned quorum (explicitly proved in `unpinned_quorum_sybil_counterexample`). |
| **4-Qubit Quantum Register / CHSH / WKB** | Exact classical simulation of a 16-amplitude complex statevector (`Float64Array`), exact Horodecki $3\times 3$ correlation-tensor CHSH, exact 4-qubit Mermin $|M_4| = 4.0$, Werner depolarizing channel, and textbook 1D rectangular-barrier WKB transmission formula. | **NOT** quantum hardware, physical entanglement, or new quantum physics; simulation scales as $O(2^n)$ and is capped at $n = 4$ qubits ($16$ complex amplitudes). |
| **24 Orders of Magnitude across 6 Scale Realms ($10^{-15}\text{ m} \to 10^9\text{ m}$)** | Six procedurally themed 3D WebGL2 visual/audio/tunnel-boost stage realms spanning logarithmic physical scale labels from femtometers to gigameters. | **NOT** a multi-scale relativistic/QFT physics engine; spatial coordinates live in a normalized $[-34, 34]$ arena coordinate system. |
| **Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas** | Programmatically audited against all **1,900** problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` ([docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md](docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md)). | **Verdict: `0 / 1,900` open problems solved.** PLANARIA is a systems engineering & formal-verification artifact adjacent to `SYS-045`, `CS-053`, `AI-005`, `BIO-031`, and `SUB-001`. |

## 2. Technical, Storage & Cryptographic Limitations

1. **Exact Storage Expansion Ratios (Transparent Overhead Disclosure):**
   - **Cell-count expansion:** `4.0×` (`192` coded cells / `48` source chunks).
   - **Canonical file vs. raw payload capacity:** `6.17×` (`98,304 B` fixed `.hbin` container / `15,936 B` maximum raw payload across all 7 bundles, due to inner RS parity, 128 B Merkle proofs, 16 B headers, and 4 B sync words).
   - **Canonical file vs. actual compiled species bytecode:** `24.6×` (`AEGIS_DRIFT`, `4,000 B` bytecode) to `57.7×` (`QUANTUM_CHRONICLE`, `1,704 B` bytecode) because `.hbin` is a fixed-size 96 KiB container reserving headroom for larger strata.
   PLANARIA is designed for compact, mission-critical, high-survivability micro-executables, NOT multi-gigabyte desktop applications.
2. **Sybil Majority Boundary in Unpinned Mode:**
   When `pinnedRootHex` is NOT supplied to `decodeHbin()`, an adversary who injects strictly more RS-valid forged cells under one coordinated fake Merkle root than surviving authentic host cells will win unpinned quorum election (`unpinned_quorum_sybil_counterexample`). For hostile channels, callers MUST pin `pinnedRootHex` (or verify against a signed manifest).
3. **128-Bit Truncated Merkle Nodes:**
   To fit an 8-level Merkle inclusion proof inside each 512 B cell ($8 \times 16 = 128\text{ B}$), internal Merkle digests truncate FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 to 128 bits. This provides 128-bit second-preimage resistance and **64-bit birthday collision resistance** — strong for single-organism forensic integrity, but below 256-bit post-quantum collision margins.
4. **JavaScript-to-Lean Extraction Gap & Model Boundaries:**
   The **85 Lean 4.35.0 theorems** verify mathematical and protocol models of $\mathrm{GF}(2^8)$, Cauchy $2\times 2$ decoding, the integer placement schedule, 4-stratum viability, RS(254,238) burst bounds, Merkle path commitment & quarantine, arbitrary-list unpinned quorum, `BitVec 32` RAM masking, dead-host xenograft refusal, 4-qubit complex unitarity, and a list-based 360-frame snapshot stack (`pushSnapshot`/`popSnapshot`).
   - The JavaScript runtime (`src/*.js`) is **not** extracted from Lean; in particular, `TemporalEngine` uses an $O(1)$ circular `RingBuffer` (vs. Lean's functional `List.take 360`), and `sha256.js` uses 128-bit truncated SHA-256 (vs. Lean's abstract injective `hashPair` with `pow2Pair` witness).
   - Runtime correspondence is bridged via the **30-suite** test harness (`test/verify.mjs`), **12/12** mutation testing (`scripts/mutation-test.mjs`), **2,000-case** seeded fuzzer (`scripts/fuzz.mjs`), clean-room **Python 3 differential oracle** (`reference/planaria_oracle.py`), and Statement-Fidelity Audit Table (`docs/reviews/2026-11-25-10-pass-red-team-audit.md`).
5. **General $k \times k$ Cauchy Non-Singularity:**
   Lean 4 proves universal $2 \times 2$ Cauchy non-singularity and exact decoding (`cauchy2_exact_decode`, `gf256_cauchy2_exact_decode` for Stratum 0 $k = 2$). Higher bundles ($k \in \{4, 6, 8, 16\}$) rely on the classical Cauchy determinant theorem in prose, randomized property tests across 25+ $(k, n)$ configurations in Suite 25, and independent Python 3 Gauss-Jordan verification in `reference/planaria_oracle.py`.
6. **Desktop-First Browser Requirements & Single-Machine Benchmarks:**
   The Studio 3D viewport requires WebGL2 (falling back gracefully to 2D PVM-32 + Tissue Surgery when unavailable). Timing benchmarks in `results/benchmarks.json` reflect one workstation (CPU/Node version recorded in JSON) and are not cross-architecture hardware guarantees. Note also that the Equal-Storage `RS(192, 48)` baseline in Experiment 1 evaluates the exact MDS rank threshold (`authenticCells >= 48`) on the same paired erasure patterns as `.hbin` rather than inverting a $48 \times 48$ matrix per trial; latency numbers therefore reflect PLANARIA's real full Cauchy decode.

## 3. Open Design Dilemmas (Logged per Build Standard R7 & R8)

- **Dilemma D1 — Non-Commercial License vs. OSI/JOSS/Mathlib Eligibility:**
  `LICENSE` uses the owner-mandated *Cosmogonic License — Non-Commercial Research & Play* (per Turn-1 explicit instruction, which takes precedence under Hard Rule `R8`; Build Standard audit tooling is explicitly carved out as CC BY 4.0). Because non-commercial clauses are not OSI-approved, PLANARIA is ineligible for JOSS submission or upstream Mathlib inclusion unless dual-licensed (e.g., Apache-2.0 / MIT) by the owner in a future release. See [ADR-0004](docs/adr/0004-non-commercial-license-vs-osi-dilemma.md).
- **Dilemma D2 — Ephemeral vs. Persistent Attestation Signing:**
  Running `npm run benchmark` without `PLANARIA_SIGNING_KEY_PEM` produces an explicitly labeled `ephemeral-self-consistency-seal` Ed25519 signature (proving internal bundle consistency only). External release authenticity relies on GitHub Release `SHA256SUMS`, SLSA provenance (`actions/attest-build-provenance@v4`), Git commit hashes, and Software Heritage snapshots.

# REPLICATION.md — Clean-Clone Reproduction & Independent Replication Protocol (`v2.4.0`)

This protocol lets any independent engineer or academic reviewer verify **every single claim, test, mutant, fuzz run, cross-language Python oracle, statistical benchmark, Lean 4.35.0 proof, interactive Blueprint, citation DOI, and PDF paper** from a clean clone using only open-source toolchains.

## 1. Prerequisites

| Tool | Required Version | Purpose | Required For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Node.js** | `>= 20.0.0` (verified on `v25.8.2` & CI `v22`) | Runtime, compiler, VM, 30 suites, 12-mutant suite, 2,000-case fuzzer, Blueprint, benchmarks (zero npm deps!) | Core build, tests, Studio |
| **Python 3** | `>= 3.10` (stdlib only, zero pip packages) | Clean-room cross-language differential oracle (`reference/planaria_oracle.py`) | Cross-language verification |
| **Lean 4 (`elan`)** | `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0` (pinned in `lean/lean-toolchain`) | 85 formal proofs (`autoImplicit = false`) + 6-kernel verification + Palomar comparator | Formal verification |
| **bubblewrap (`bwrap`)** | Linux only (`sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap`) | Sandboxed `lake check --paranoid` & `lake comparator --paranoid` (+ negative tamper check) | Linux 6-kernel sandbox |
| **Tectonic** | `>= 0.15` (optional) | Recompile `paper/main.tex` -> `dist/Donahue_2026_planaria.pdf` | White paper PDF build |

## 2. Exact Clean-Clone Reproduction Commands

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/planaria.git
cd planaria

# 1. Deterministic build of all 4 living .hbin organisms (98,304 B each)
npm run build

# 2. Full 30-suite verification, property-based, metamorphic, DSP & regression harness
npm test

# 3. Clean-room Python 3 cross-language differential oracle (768 cells + mitosis + 4Q CHSH/Mermin)
python3 reference/planaria_oracle.py

# 4. Deterministic 2,000-case adversarial fuzzer (decodeHbin, Plang, RS, PVM-32)
npm run fuzz

# 5. Surgical mutation testing (12 planted mutants -> expect 12/12 = 100.0% KILLED)
npm run mutate

# 6. Static analysis, cross-doc Lean theorem linter, README axiom check, Blueprint check & live Crossref DOI audit
npm run lint
npm run check:axioms
npm run blueprint && npm run check:blueprint
npm run check:citations -- --live

# 7. Reproducible 4-architecture Monte Carlo + Wilson 95% CI + McNemar + Holm-Bonferroni benchmarks
npm run benchmark

# 8. Pure Lean 4.35.0 build & verbatim 85-theorem #print axioms audit (autoImplicit = false)
cd lean
lake clean && lake build
lake build Challenge
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
lake env leanchecker-paranoid --fresh Solution

# 9. Full 6-kernel sandboxed verification & Palomar Challenge/Solution comparator (Linux with bwrap)
lake check --paranoid
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
cd ..

# 10. Optional: recompile AMS-LaTeX White Paper PDF
npm run paper

# 11. Launch live 3D WebGL2 Studio (http://127.0.0.1:4174/) & Proof Blueprint (http://127.0.0.1:4174/blueprint/)
npm start
```

Or run the full automated pipeline via `just reproduce` (or `./scripts/dev.sh reproduce`).

# PLANARIA Architecture (`v2.4.0`)

## System Overview

PLANARIA replaces monolithic header-dependent executables with **headerless, spatially stratified holographic cellular binaries (`.hbin`)** paired with a fault-isolated register virtual machine (`PVM-32`) capable of autonomous multi-stratum control-flow anastomosis. Every byte of a compiled `98,304`-byte `.hbin` organism consists exclusively of `192` self-synchronizing `512`-byte cellular frames arranged via an exact-integer low-discrepancy placement schedule (`PLACEMENT_SCHEDULE`) so that arbitrary 50/50 spatial cuts (including prime unaligned byte offsets) partition the organism with zero byte overlap while preserving full algebraic reconstructibility.

```text
  .plang Source (4 Living Species)
        │  src/compiler/{lexer,parser,codegen,isa}.js
        ▼
  7 Organ Bundles (exact BUNDLE_SPECS in src/core/hbin.js, total k=48, n=192):
    ├── Stratum 0: B0 S0_STEM_NUCLEUS   (k=2,  n=24, cap=664 B)   [sovereign, 91.7% loss tol]
    ├── Stratum 1: B1 S1_CORE_LOGIC     (k=4,  n=24, cap=1,328 B) [xenograftable]
    │              B2 S1_WIREFRAME      (k=4,  n=24, cap=1,328 B) [xenograftable]
    ├── Stratum 2: B3 S2_CORTEX_RENDER  (k=8,  n=32, cap=2,656 B) [xenograftable]
    │              B4 S2_SYNTH_AUDIO    (k=6,  n=24, cap=1,992 B) [xenograftable]
    └── Stratum 3: B5 S3_ORGANISM_FX    (k=16, n=40, cap=5,312 B) [xenograftable]
                   B6 S3_GENOME_LEDGER  (k=8,  n=24, cap=2,656 B) [sovereign, non-executable]
        │  Each 512 B Cell = 4 B Sync ('PLN\xB7') + 2x Interleaved RS(254,238) (508 B)
        │                  = 476 B Body (16 B Header + 332 B Cauchy Shard + 8x16 B Merkle Proof) + 32 B Parity
        ▼
  192-Cell Exact-Integer Placement Scheduled .hbin Binary (98,304 B)
        │  decodeHbin() -> Fuzzy Sync Scan (<=3b) + Dense-Flood Guard + ±512 B Cadence Flywheel
        │               -> 2x Interleaved RS(254,238) Repair (<=8 B/lane, 16 B burst)
        │               -> Depth-8 Domain-Separated SHA-256-128 Merkle Quarantine (0x00/0x01/0x02)
        │               -> GF(2^8) Cauchy MDS Recovery + Optional ABI-Verified Xenografting
        ▼
  PVM-32 Sandboxed Virtual Machine (src/vm/pvm32.js)
    ├── 32x32-bit regs (r0=0, r1..r7 ABI, r8..r17 scratch, r18..r31 callee/local frame)
    ├── 4,096-word RAM strictly masked (& 0xFFF), 16,000-insn default fuel + proportional blitter fuel
    ├── Transactional RAM & voice rollback on organ traps; ORGAN_CALL descending anastomosis
    └── Live coupling to 4-Qubit Register + Temporal RingBuffer + WebGL2 3D + 48 kHz AudioWorklet
```

## Layer 1 — Coding Theory, Cryptography & Cellular Codec (`src/core/`)

| Module | Responsibility | Key Invariants |
|---|---|---|
| `gf256.js` | $\mathrm{GF}(2^8)$ arithmetic (`0x11D`, generator `0x02`) | Exhaustively verified over all $65{,}536$ pairs & $16{,}777{,}216$ triples (`Suite 01`, `Planaria.GF256`) |
| `rs.js` | 2-way interleaved `RS(254, 238)` Berlekamp–Massey / Chien / Forney | Repairs $\le 8$ random errors/lane ($16$ B contiguous burst per cell); strictly rejects $9+$ errors/lane (`Suite 02`, `Planaria.Byzantine`) |
| `cauchy.js` | Systematic-free Cauchy MDS over $\mathrm{GF}(2^8)$ ($C_{i,j} = (x_i \oplus y_j)^{-1}$) | Any $k$ distinct `evalX` shards invert losslessly (`k <= 128`, deduplicated); $2\times 2$ non-singularity proved universally (`Planaria.GF256.gf256_cauchy2_exact_decode`) |
| `sha256.js` | Pure JS FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 + Depth-8 Merkle tree (`0x00` leaf / `0x01` internal / `0x02 \|\| "PLN\0"` empty) | Bit-exact parity with Node OpenSSL & Python `hashlib` (`Suite 03`, `reference/planaria_oracle.py`); full-path commitment (`Planaria.Byzantine.merkle_path_collision_free_binding`) |
| `hbin.js` | 192-cell `PLACEMENT_SCHEDULE`, fuzzy sync scanner, dense-flood guard, ±512 B flywheel, Merkle quarantine, xenograft engine | Zero-overlap exact/prime mitosis (`Planaria.Mitosis`), 1-cell unpinned fail-closed quorum, dead-host xenograft refusal (`Planaria.Xenograft.xenograft_dead_host_refused`), deterministic code-point donor tie-break |
| `torture.js` | Deterministic damage injectors (bisection, trisection, bit-rot, burst, unaligned shift, Trojan, overlap-eclipse, flywheel amputation) | Exact seeded Mulberry32 PRNG for paired Monte Carlo comparisons |

### Exact-Integer Placement Schedule (`PLACEMENT_SCHEDULE`)

Every cell `(bundleId b, cellInBundle i)` across all 7 bundles `(k, n_b) ∈ {(2,24),(4,24),(4,24),(8,32),(6,24),(16,40),(8,24)}` receives the exact integer numerator:

```text
posNum(b, i, n_b) = (14 * i + 2 * b + 1) * (480 / n_b)  ∈ (0, 6720)
```

Cells are placed in strictly ascending lexicographic order of `(posNum, b, i)` (zero IEEE-754 tie-break drift). Because `480 % n_b == 0` for every bundle and `posNum != 3360` for all 192 cells, slots `0..95` contain **exactly** `n_b / 2 >= k_b + 2` cells of every bundle and slots `96..191` contain **exactly** `n_b / 2 >= k_b + 2` cells (`Planaria.Mitosis.planaria_schedule_exact_halves`, `Planaria.Mitosis.planaria_schedule_nodup_and_sorted_halves`).

## Layer 2 — Plang Compiler & `PVM-32` Virtual Machine (`src/compiler/`, `src/vm/`)

- **Plang Language (`lexer.js`, `parser.js`, `codegen.js`, `isa.js`):** Compiles structured 7-bundle living organisms (`programs/*.plang`) to fixed-width 32-bit RISC bytecode. Enforces `MAX_PARSE_DEPTH = 128` across blocks, `else if`, and ternary chains, iterative AST `containsCall` + `MAX_AST_DEPTH = 256`, `Map`-based symbol tables (immune to `Object.prototype` collisions), strict scratch-register overflow guard (`rR > 17`), built-in constant/organ protection, deterministic `LI r1, 0` on bare `return;`, and strict signed 32-bit decimal range checks (hex `0x...` required for bit-patterns `> 2147483647`).
- **`PVM-32` (`pvm32.js`):** Deterministic 32-bit virtual machine with `& 0xFFF` RAM address sandboxing, exact `BigInt` integer square root (`ISQRT`), default `16,000`-instruction per-frame budget + proportional blitter fuel (`GLOW` 128, `CLEAR` 64, `TRI` 4, `LINE` 2), transactional RAM/voice rollback on organ traps, strict Bundle 6 non-execution (`bundleCode[6] === null`), and `ORGAN_CALL` vascular anastomosis.
- **Control Baselines (`linear-twin.js`, `scripts/benchmark.mjs`):** `LINBIN01` traditional headered linear binary with SHA-256 footer, plus single-stratum `RS(40,16)` and equal-storage flat `RS(192,48)` monolithic archive baselines.

## Layer 3 — 4-Qubit Quantum Engine, Temporal Causality & WebGL2 Studio (`src/quantum/`, `src/world/`, `src/web/`)

- **Quantum Register (`qengine.js`):** Exact $2^4 = 16$-amplitude complex double-precision statevector supporting `X/Y/Z/H/S/T/RX/RY/RZ/CNOT/CZ/SWAP`, Werner depolarizing decoherence ($V = e^{-\gamma t} \to 0$) honored during projective readout, exact Horodecki $3\times 3$ correlation-tensor CHSH maximum $S_{\max} = 2\sqrt{\lambda_0 + \lambda_1}$ (reaching $2\sqrt{2} \approx 2.8284$ on Bell states), 4-qubit Mermin $|M_4|$ witness (reaching **$|M_4| = 4.0$** on $\mathrm{GHZ}_4$), WKB barrier tunneling, Heisenberg uncertainty, and Zeno suppression.
- **Temporal Engine (`temporal.js`):** $O(1)$ circular 360-frame `RingBuffer` recording full deep-copied world snapshots (player kinematics, HP, XP, skills, weapons, armors, indices, recent loot, player profile, deterministic Mulberry32 RNG state, quantum amplitudes & gate counter, active NPCs, delayed echo shots, chrono wells, echo clones) enabling causality-consistent rewind with zero inventory or skill-point exploits.
- **3D World & WebGL2 Renderer (`generator.js`, `game3d.js`, `renderer3d.js`, `audio-worklet.js`):** Deterministic 64-bit seeded 6-realm stage & gear generator spanning 24 orders of magnitude (`6,421,059,993,600` reachable discrete combinations), pure WebGL2 GLSL 300 es pipeline with organ-amputation degradation (`S0`–`S3`), plus a lock-free 48 kHz PolyBLEP `AudioWorklet` synthesizer coupled to `PVM-32` Bundle 4.

## Layer 4 — CLI, Hardened HTTP Server, Python Oracle & Static Pages (`bin/`, `server.mjs`, `reference/`, `scripts/`)

- **CLI (`bin/planaria.mjs`):** 9 subcommands (`compile`, `inspect`, `run`, `bisect`, `fuse`, `heal`, `damage`, `xenograft`, `disasm`), 16 MiB bounded file reader, distinct-output guards, `--allow-partial`, `--include-sync`, `--allow-unpinned-xenograft`, exit code `2` on non-bootable organism, exit code `3` on VM traps.
- **HTTP Server (`server.mjs`):** Zero-dependency static host bound to `127.0.0.1:4174` serving `/` (Studio), `/blueprint/` (Interactive Lean Blueprint), and `/healthz`, with TOCTOU-safe `openSync`/`fstatSync`, symlink-escape protection, strict CSP, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `nosniff`, `/src/web/index.html -> /` 302 redirect, and graceful `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM` shutdown.
- **Clean-Room Python 3 Oracle (`reference/planaria_oracle.py`):** Independent pure-Python stdlib implementation decoding all 4 `.hbin` binaries (768 cells), unaligned mitosis (`49,177 B`), and 4-qubit CHSH/Mermin invariants.

## Layer 5 — 6-Kernel Pure Lean 4.35.0 Proofs & Interactive Blueprint (`lean/`, `blueprint/`, `formalization.yaml`)

Seven zero-Mathlib `module` files (`GF256`, `MitosisBounds`, `StratumAnastomosis`, `ByzantineImmune`, `XenograftABI`, `QuantumTemporal`, `AdversarialTests`) built with `autoImplicit = false` & `relaxedAutoImplicit = false` prove **85 theorems** using only Lean's standard axioms `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`, exported via Palomar `Challenge.lean` / `Solution.lean` / `comparator.json` and independently checked across 6 distinct kernels (`lean4`, `leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, plus `lean4lean` & `lake comparator --paranoid` + negative tampering check in Ubuntu Linux CI) and visualized in `blueprint/index.html`.

## 1. Paired 4-Architecture Random Erasure Survival Curve (`N = 40` Paired Seeds / Point)

Compares `AEGIS_DRIFT.hbin` (`98,304` B, `1,000` insns, `4,000` B code) against three baselines evaluated on the **exact same 40 deterministic random seeds** per erasure threshold:
1. **`LINBIN01`**: Monolithic headered linear executable with SHA-256 footer.
2. **`RS(40, 16)` Cliff**: Single-stratum flat erasure code ($40$ cells, $k = 16$).
3. **Equal-Storage Flat `RS(192, 48)`**: Exact same `98,304` B file size and `192 × 512` B cell count as PLANARIA, evaluated via its exact MDS rank threshold (`authenticCells >= 48`, `25%` survival cliff) on the same paired erasure masks to isolate **progressive stratification** from total byte budget.

| Erasure (%) | `LINBIN01` (%) [95% CI] | `RS(40,16)` (%) | Equal-Storage `RS(192,48)` (%) [95% CI] | **PLANARIA `.hbin`** (%) [95% CI] | Mean Cap. (%) | Stratum (`S3/S2/S1/S0`) | vs. `RS(192,48)` Cohen's $h$ | vs. `RS(192,48)` $p_{\text{Holm}}$ |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|:---:|---:|---:|
| 0% | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | 100.0 | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | 100.0 | `40/0/0/0` | `0.000` | `1.000` |

| 44% | 0.0 `[0.0, 8.8]` | 100.0 | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | 100.0 | `40/0/0/0` | `0.000` | `1.000` |
| 60% | 0.0 `[0.0, 8.8]` | 57.5 | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | 88.8 | `22/18/0/0` | `0.000` | `1.000` |
| 72% | 0.0 `[0.0, 8.8]` | 2.5 | 100.0 `[91.2, 100.0]` | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | 72.5 | `0/36/4/0` | `0.000` | `1.000` |
| **76%** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` | **0.0** | **0.0** `[0.0, 8.8]` *(Cliff)* | **100.0** `[91.2, 100.0]` | **65.6** | `0/25/15/0` | **`3.142`** | **`4.55e-11`** |

**Honest Trade-Off Note:** Between `52%` and `72%` random erasure, Equal-Storage `RS(192, 48)` recovers 100% of all bytes (full Stratum 3) whenever $\ge 48/192$ cells survive, whereas PLANARIA gracefully steps down to Stratum 2 (`S2`) and Stratum 1 (`S1`) as higher-rate bundles drop below their thresholds. Above `75%` erasure, Equal-Storage `RS(192, 48)` suffers an instantaneous cliff to `0.0%` availability, while PLANARIA remains bootable with statistically overwhelming superiority ($p_{\text{Holm}} \le 4.88 \times 10^{-3}$ across every threshold `76%..96%`).

---

## 2. Radiation Burst Sweep, Byzantine Quarantine & Unaligned Mitosis

- **Contiguous Burst Radiation in ALL 192 Cells Simultaneously:**
  - `0..16 B/cell` (up to `3,072` corrupted bytes = `3.13%` file-wide): **192/192 cells repaired (100% SHA-256 exact regeneration)**; `LINBIN01` dies at `2 B/cell`.
  - `18..22 B/cell` (past tight interleaved RS bound $2t = 16$): **0/192 cells repaired, 0 silent miscorrections** (confirms Theorem IV tight bounds and `AdversarialTests.lean`).
- **Byzantine Trojan Flood (`1, 5, 20, 60, 192` forged RS-valid cells prepended):**
  - **Merkle Quarantine ON:** `100%` quarantined (`1/1`, `5/5`, `20/20`, `60/60`, `192/192`), `100%` exact SHA-256 match.
  - **Merkle Quarantine OFF:** Even **1 single Trojan** poisons `469 / 472` bytes (`99.4%`) of `S0_STEM_NUCLEUS` (`469–472 B` across `1..192` Trojans).
- **Zero-Overlap Unaligned 50/50 Bisection (`49152, 49153, 49177, 48701, 49597, 49000`):**
  - **100% (6/6 cut offsets)** regenerate SHA-256 bit-exact `98,304`-byte parent binaries from **BOTH** disjoint halves in `17.17–21.28 ms` combined (`49177`: `20.20 ms`, also verified bit-exact in `reference/planaria_oracle.py`).
- **Full 5-Chimera Cross-Species Xenograft Matrix (`60` frames each):**
  - `AEGIS_DRIFT × SYNTH_REACTOR (S2 Render+Audio)` — Bootable S3, Host B0 Sovereign, **0 traps**
  - `AEGIS_DRIFT × CIPHER_VAULT (S2 Render+Audio)` — Bootable S3, Host B0 Sovereign, **0 traps**
  - `AEGIS_DRIFT × QUANTUM_CHRONICLE (S1 Logic)` — Bootable S3, Host B0 Sovereign, **0 traps**
  - `QUANTUM_CHRONICLE × SYNTH_REACTOR (S2 Render+Audio)` — Bootable S3, Host B0 Sovereign, **0 traps**
  - `SYNTH_REACTOR × CIPHER_VAULT (S2 Render+Audio)` — Bootable S3, Host B0 Sovereign, **0 traps**

---

## Executive Verdict

**PLANARIA v2.4.0 solves ZERO (`0 / 1,900`) open problems in the Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas.**

PLANARIA is an original computer-systems, binary-architecture, compiler, virtual-machine, and formal-verification engineering artifact (`Progressive Holographic Instruction Stratification`, `.hbin` format, `Plang`, `PVM-32` anastomosis, Merkle Byzantine quarantine, ABI-verified cross-species xenografting, and 85 pure Lean 4.35.0 formal theorems checked across 6 kernels). None of those systems achievements resolves an open conjecture in pure mathematics, theoretical computer science, quantum physics, or developmental biology.

Publishing this explicit negative audit prevents claim inflation, respects Popperian falsifiability, and maps the exact distance between PLANARIA's verified engineering guarantees and adjacent open scientific frontiers.
